name: Minecraft: Time Capsule
summary:
Add a Minecraft time capsule to your world! Modeled after the real-life
capsule in Redmond, WA, this in-game version lets you decorate it, store
treasures, and set a timer of up to 15 years to lock them away. Stored
items even get unique labels showing how long they’ve been preserved.
Save your treasures for memory lane
